## Environment

Wiki version or commit, operating system, Node/Git versions, and agent client/version
(if used). Please use the synthetic example; omit private paths and account details.

## How far did you get?

- [ ] Started the example
- [ ] Followed an article citation to an original trace
- [ ] Connected an agent and obtained a sourced answer
- [ ] Saved an edit and inspected its history
- [ ] Started a separate content repository

## Result

What was the last successful step? What happened next, and what did you expect?
Were you able to finish without maintainer help? If you returned to use the wiki,
what made it useful? Success reports are welcome too.

Include only synthetic reproductions. Do not attach real articles, conversations,
credentials, or customer data. Report vulnerabilities through SECURITY.md.
